paper: Bifrost-1: Bridging Multimodal LLMs and Diffusion Models with Patch-level CLIP Latents
scope: Optimize the pretrained 28-layer patch-latent decoder execution graph and tensor lifetimes. No retraining, FLUX renderer or full-paper image-quality claim.

candidate_interface.method_py_execution: Local network-none Docker only; emits a bounded tensor-computation DAG.
candidate_interface.program_json_execution: Validated data-only DAG interpreted or explicitly bounded-region compiled by the trusted CUDA worker; no candidate Python imports.
allowed_changes: bounded contiguous compile region grouping with the fixed trusted Inductor backend
forbidden: altering hidden inputs or quality rules

compilation_limits.executable_cache_scope: one trusted short-lived CUDA job; no cross-job or cross-role reuse

baseline.algorithm: Published eager dense dual-branch decoder with pretrained BF16 weights, all28 layers, unchanged row dimensions and use_cache=false.
baseline.role: Runnable Starter, formal paired Baseline and normalization anchor0 share the same semantics.

protocol.sampling_order: Fixed seeded torch.randperm; cosine reveal schedule; per-patch CFG.
protocol.semantics_disclosure: This is a canonical decoder benchmark. The published multi-patch CFG indexing is not claimed to be reproduced unchanged.
protocol.quality_plan: Check every full-decoder prediction on the shared Baseline replay; additionally run an autonomous candidate rollout and compare final latent tokens. Both reset all per-prefix mutable state.
protocol.warmup: For each case, one untimed source-alignment/Starter/candidate warmup; reset every prefix cache before each timed repetition.
protocol.cost_inclusion: Sum of256 CUDA-event decoder forwards per rollout:28 layers, final vision RMS norm and projection head, including first-step cache construction and tensor operations. CFG/reveal/input concatenation/rotary setup, quality diagnostics, loading, queueing and authenticated transport are excluded equally and disclosed.
protocol.seed_type: Inference sampling seed; no independent training or retraining claim.
protocol.raw_data: Retain each stage timing/delta, independent final latent tensors, source alignment, source/checkpoint/input/config hashes, CUDA-child exit and post-job GPU idle receipt.

metric.name: mean_total256_decoder_forward_cuda_event_latency_ms
metric.aggregation: Median of3 paired repetitions per prompt; arithmetic mean of2 prompts per sampling seed; arithmetic mean of the3 per-seed means. Sample SD uses n-1 across the3 Baseline per-seed means.
metric.upper_anchor_basis: Nonnegative elapsed time has the universal ideal lower bound0ms; this anchor is not fitted to Reference outcomes.
metric.normalized_reward: (B-T)/(B-U), U=0ms, without clipping or baseline identity override for valid quality/resource runs. Hard-gate invalid score=-1, excluded from valid ranking.
metric.noise_requirement: Paired mean latency reduction >=3 times the sample standard deviation of all Baseline per-seed raw aggregate latencies.

runtime.agent: Local Docker Desktop Linux ARM64, keyless native Codex, networknone, separate role volume and workspace.
runtime.verifier: Separate local Docker image; consumes data-only candidate artifact and a physically separate trusted queue.
runtime.compute: Trusted A100 worker with frozen engine and weights; no candidate shell or Python imports.
runtime.target_harness: Harbor0.23.0 Docker with explicit remote-compute adapter; no claim of native Docker GPU passthrough on macOS.
runtime.native_NOP: Required on the frozen current task and actual separate Verifier; generic CUDA or model preflight does not count.
